career_ladder.note: Non-Executive personnel in Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) are appointed in Non-Executive Grade IV across Refineries, Pipelines, and Marketing Divisions. Promotion across non-executive grades is governed by time-bound and merit-cum-seniority non-executive promotion agreements, leading to supervisory cadres and eligibility for induction into the Executive Cadre (Officer Grade A) through internal departmental promotion examinations.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Non-Executive Personnel in IOCL is conducted through a two-stage process comprising an Objective Written Test / Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The SPPT is of qualifying nature only; final merit is prepared exclusively from marks secured in the Written Test.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Written Test / Computer Based Test (CBT)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% (35% for SC/ST/PwBD) in aggregate written test

papers.paper_name: Trade Skill Assessment / Physical Efficiency & Endurance (for Fire & Safety)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying (Candidates must be adjudged 'Suitable' by the trade testing committee)

financial_package.note: Remuneration for Non-Executive personnel in IOCL is determined by the DPE 3rd PRC Wage Settlement for Unionized Non-Executive Employees. Entry basic pay in Grade IV is ₹25,000 in the scale of ₹25,000–₹1,05,000, with mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, 35% cafeteria perks, HRA (9% to 27%), shift allowance, refinery operational allowances, and comprehensive medical care.
financial_package.pay_source_label: IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment Terms (Scale of Pay & Emoluments)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹25,000, 58% IDA (₹14,500), Cafeteria perks @ 35% (₹8,750), and HRA (9% to 27% = ₹2,250 to ₹6,750), plus continuous shift allowance where applicable, less statutory deductions for PF (12% of Basic + DA = ₹4,740) and defined pension contribution.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly per AICPI
Cafeteria Approach Allowances @ 35% of Basic Pay
House Rent Allowance (HRA) @ 9%, 18%, or 27% / Township accommodation in IOCL refinery colonies
Continuous Shift Allowance and Night Shift Allowance for plant operational staff
Contributory Provident Fund (CPF), Gratuity, and Superannuation Pension Fund
Comprehensive medical treatment for employee and dependent family members in IOCL refinery hospitals and empaneled healthcare centers
Uniform subsidy, washing allowance, and safety equipment kit
